anomalies.observed: C1 is 100pF and C2 is 100nF. C2 is the output capacitor for the LM1117-5.0 regulator (U1).
anomalies.expected: The LM1117 datasheet requires a minimum output capacitance of 10 µF for stability. C2 should be at least 10 µF. C1, as input capacitor, should also be larger (typically 10 µF) if required.
anomalies.impact: The LM1117 may oscillate or be unstable, causing the +5V rail to be noisy or out of regulation, potentially affecting the MCUs and other 5V components.

anomalies.observed: Net Net-(J1-Pin_1) connects only J1 pin 1 and J6 pin 1. It is not connected to any power or ground net.
anomalies.expected: J1 pin 1 (likely VCC for the I2C connector) should be connected to the +5V rail, or J6 pin 1 should be connected to GND if J6 is an I2C power connector.
anomalies.impact: The I2C connector J1 pin 1 is unpowered, so any I2C device connected to J1 will not receive power. J6 is also not a functional power connector.

anomalies.observed: J1 is labeled 'I2C' but its pin 3 is connected to the SCK net (SPI clock), not an I2C SCL net. There is no SCL net in the design.
anomalies.expected: An I2C connector should have SCL on the clock pin. If J1 is intended for I2C, pin 3 should be connected to an SCL net, not SCK.
anomalies.impact: If J1 is used as an I2C interface, the I2C clock is missing, so I2C communication will not work.
